lvmgroups.description: List of LVMed iSCSI Volume Groups to activate at boot, space-separated.

handle_netdev.description: Handle _netdev devices (1 for yes, 0 for no).

exclude_mounts_at_shutdown.description: Additional mounts to exclude at shutdown, space-separated with escaped spaces.

iscsi_root_keep_all_sessions_at_shutdown.description: Don't logout from ANY iSCSI session on shutdown (1 for yes, 0 for no).
